properties.name: numberOfElements
properties.label: Number of Timeline Items
properties.tooltip: Define number of timeline items to display (1-20)

properties.name: animationStyle
properties.label: Scroll Animation
properties.tooltip: Animation effect when items scroll into view

properties.name: hoverEffect
properties.label: Enable Hover Effect
properties.tooltip: Add subtle lift effect when hovering over timeline items

properties.name: tmBgColor
properties.label: Background Color
properties.tooltip: Background color of the entire timeline section

properties.name: tmCenterlineBgColor
properties.label: Timeline Line Color
properties.tooltip: Color of the vertical timeline line

properties.name: tmCircleBgColor
properties.label: Circle Border Color
properties.tooltip: Border color of timeline marker circles

properties.name: tmCircleFillColor
properties.label: Circle Fill Color
properties.tooltip: Fill color inside the marker circles

properties.name: connectorColor
properties.label: Connector Arrow Color
properties.tooltip: Color of the arrow connector (usually matches content background)

properties.name: tmContentBGColor
properties.label: Content Box Background
properties.tooltip: Background color of timeline content boxes

properties.name: contentBorderRadius
properties.label: Content Corner Radius (px)
properties.tooltip: Roundness of content box corners (0 = square, 30 = very round)

properties.name: containerPadding
properties.label: Container Inner Padding (px)
properties.tooltip: Internal top and bottom padding inside container
